meta.qi_triple_negative_result: 0 strict QI-triples in gamemd.exe. Corpus-wide vptr slot attribution: single-slot receivers (4:)=259, (8:)=142, (0:)=33; partial pairs (0,8)=2, (4,8)=1; no (0,4,8). Permissive relaxation (group vptr loads by source-operand glyph, ignoring receiver identity) yields 2 candidates (0x685670, 0x685DC0) -- both manually disproven: the '[ecx]' glyph holds DIFFERENT receivers at different sites (dword_887640 / dword_887628 / dword_A8B23C within Scenario::EndGameFlow). RA2 game code only ever calls Release/dtor (slot 0 or 8) on COM receivers; full QueryInterface+AddRef+Release triples live inside ole32, not the exe. Client-side COM identity is instead recoverable via evidence class 3 (guid_compare).
